order_0.description: Foundation atoms. Never expand. Only score.

f1_measure_jps.signature: node → {jps: float, human_j: float, useful_j: float}

order_n.rule: n^n sparse recursive. Only active path evaluated. Never materialize full lattice.
order_n.raise_order: replace bottleneck atom with composition of (n+1) lower units

layer_0_axioms.name: landauer
layer_0_axioms.statement: kT ln2 joules per bit erased. Minimum human cost of irreversible computation.

layer_0_axioms.name: observe_and_interact
layer_0_axioms.statement: Measure before acting. Sensor → condition → possibility.

layer_0_axioms.name: catch_and_store_energy
layer_0_axioms.statement: Every computation must leave residual useful work (cache, hash, ledger).

layer_0_axioms.name: produce_no_waste
layer_0_axioms.statement: Redundant code or unused imports are pure human_joules.

layer_0_axioms.name: use_and_value_diversity
layer_0_axioms.statement: Multiple independent atomic paths increase robustness.

layer_0_axioms.name: use_edges
layer_0_axioms.statement: Bottleneck is always at the edge between modules. Optimize interfaces first.
layer_0_axioms.score: prefer interface rewrite over body rewrite

layer_0_axioms.name: acts_20_35
layer_0_axioms.statement: It is more blessed to give than to receive. Maximize utility for the next user/system.

layer_0_axioms.name: more_with_less
layer_0_axioms.statement: Fuller: do more with less. Reject any solution where Input_J > Output_J by any margin.

layer_0_axioms.name: tensegrity
layer_0_axioms.statement: Continuous tension + discontinuous compression. Prefer sparse high-order composition over dense low-order.

layer_0_axioms.name: self_replication
layer_0_axioms.statement: Pattern that works at order n must be usable at order n+1 without rewrite.

layer_0_axioms.name: minimal_surface
layer_0_axioms.statement: Code surface area (API + lines) minimized for given useful volume.

layer_1_verified.statement: Surgical rewrite of bottleneck in core_atomic.py raised η by 3.8390

bottleneck_protocol.1: Run f1 on every node → rank by jps / useful
bottleneck_protocol.2: Select highest cost / lowest η node
bottleneck_protocol.3: Raise order of that node by composing 3 lower units
bottleneck_protocol.4: Re-score entire path with f2 under all layer_0 axioms
bottleneck_protocol.5: Commit with f3 → merkle root becomes ACRE claim seed
